protocol.zero_leakage: Full exhaustive evaluation across all canonical RE1 (375 cases) and RE2 (270 cases) real Kubernetes/OpenTelemetry incidents (total 645 cases) using frozen v0.1.0 defaults (lag=2, forgetting=0.995, normalize_scale=1), zero retuning, zero test-case peeking.
protocol.symmetric_comparators: Identical strictly causal imputation (ffill then 0.0, never bfill), identical <service>_<metric> parser, and symmetric max-over-metrics service aggregation across all methods. causalsieve_blind and causalsieve_tier2 receive ZERO inject_time knowledge; causalsieve, baro_fse24, nsigma_rcaeval, circa_structural_rca, rolling_mad_z, and pairwise_granger_z share the exact pre/post inject_index split.
